method: Same seed/seat/profile guard vs conditional-sacrifice; audit conditional-only accepted sacrifice placements against counterfactual guard action at identical pre-move state. Actual opponent hands used only AFTER move choice for audit; never in policy.
limitations: Provisional four-branch opening; selected rare events and correlated repeated choices; outcomes from full divergent trajectories, not isolated causal effects; simple bots; uniform unknown allocation without prior-action likelihood; no block winner; finish-first != match victory; seed-cluster CI exploratory and uncorrected.
next: Do not retune thresholds on this holdout; use event strata to formulate a genuinely new predeclared hypothesis, then validate with independent seeds. Obtain real locked/open branch fixture.

analysis.predeclaredFocus: late-game <=3 focal stones among accepted conditional sacrifices; compare matched guard trajectory, no threshold tuning
analysis.interpretation: Exploratory selected-event contrasts; late events are rare, seed/profile dependence and prior policy selection prevent causal or universal claim. No hidden-world Monte Carlo in this run.
analysis.tests: audit.test deterministic replay and prior-run regression passed; 36 test continuations excluded
